lines.gurmukhi: ਰਾਗੁ ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ਘਰੁ ੧ ਦੁਪਦੇ ॥
lines.transliteration: raag bairaaRee mahalaa 4 ghar 1 dupade ||
lines.translation: Raag Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl, First House, Dho-Padhay:

lines.gurmukhi: ੴ ਸਤਿਗੁਰ ਪ੍ਰਸਾਦਿ ॥
lines.transliteration: ikOankaar satigur prasaad ||
lines.translation: One Universal Creator God. By The Grace Of The True Guru:

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਨਿ ਮਨ ਅਕਥ ਕਥਾ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sun man akath kathaa har naam ||
lines.translation: Listen, O mind, to the Unspoken Speech of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਰਿਧਿ ਬੁਧਿ ਸਿਧਿ ਸੁਖ ਪਾਵਹਿ ਭਜੁ ਗੁਰਮਤਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ਰਾਮ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: ridh budh sidh sukh paavahi bhaj guramat har raam raam ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Riches, wisdom, supernatural spiritual powers and peace are obtained, by vibrating, meditating on the Lord God, under Guru's Instruction. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਾ ਖਿਆਨ ਪੁਰਾਨ ਜਸੁ ਊਤਮ ਖਟ ਦਰਸਨ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਰਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: naanaa khiaan puraan jas ootam khat darasan gaavahi raam ||
lines.translation: Numerous legends, the Puraanas, and the six Shaastras, sing the sublime Praises of the Lord.

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੰਕਰ ਕ੍ਰੋੜਿ ਤੇਤੀਸ ਧਿਆਇਓ ਨਹੀ ਜਾਨਿਓ ਹਰਿ ਮਰਮਾਮ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: sa(n)kar kroR tetees dhiaaio nahee jaanio har maramaam ||1||
lines.translation: Shiva and the three hundred thirty million gods meditate on the Lord, but they do not know the secret of His mystery. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਸੁਰਿ ਨਰ ਗਣ ਗੰਧ੍ਰਬ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਵਹਿ ਸਭ ਗਾਵਤ ਜੇਤ ਉਪਾਮ ॥
lines.transliteration: sur nar gan ga(n)dhrab jas gaavahi sabh gaavat jet upaam ||
lines.translation: The angelic and divine beings, and the celestial singers sing His Praises; all Creation sings of Him.

lines.gurmukhi: ਨਾਨਕ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਹਰਿ ਜਿਨ ਕਉ ਤੇ ਸੰਤ ਭਲੇ ਹਰਿ ਰਾਮ ॥੨॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: naanak kripaa karee har jin kau te sa(n)t bhale har raam ||2||1||
lines.translation: O Nanak, those whom the Lord blesses with His Kind Mercy, become the good Saints of the Lord God. ||2||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: bairaaRee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਮਨ ਮਿਲਿ ਸੰਤ ਜਨਾ ਜਸੁ ਗਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: man mil sa(n)t janaa jas gaaio ||
lines.translation: O mind, those who meet the Lord's humble servants, sing His Praises.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਰਤਨੁ ਰਤਨੁ ਹਰਿ ਨੀਕੋ ਗੁਰਿ ਸਤਿਗੁਰਿ ਦਾਨੁ ਦਿਵਾਇਓ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: har har ratan ratan har neeko gur satigur daan divaaio ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: They are blessed with the gift of the jewel of the Lord, Har, Har, the sublime jewel of the Lord, by the Guru, the True Guru. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਤਿਸੁ ਜਨ ਕਉ ਮਨੁ ਤਨੁ ਸਭੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਨਾਮੁ ਸੁਨਾਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: tis jan kau man tan sabh devau jin har har naam sunaaio ||
lines.translation: I offer my mind, body and everything to that humble being who recites the Name of the Lord, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਧਨੁ ਮਾਇਆ ਸੰਪੈ ਤਿਸੁ ਦੇਵਉ ਜਿਨਿ ਹਰਿ ਮੀਤੁ ਮਿਲਾਇਓ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: dhan maaiaa sa(n)pai tis devau jin har meet milaaio ||1||
lines.translation: I offer my wealth, the riches of Maya and my property to that one who leads me to meet the Lord, my friend. ||1||

lines.gurmukhi: ਖਿਨੁ ਕਿੰਚਿਤ ਕ੍ਰਿਪਾ ਕਰੀ ਜਗਦੀਸਰਿ ਤਬ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਹਰਿ ਜਸੁ ਧਿਆਇਓ ॥
lines.transliteration: khin ki(n)chit kripaa karee jagadeesar tab har har har jas dhiaaio ||
lines.translation: When the Lord of the world bestowed just a tiny bit of His Mercy, for just an instant, then I meditated on the Praise of the Lord, Har, Har, Har.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜਨ ਨਾਨਕ ਕਉ ਹਰਿ ਭੇਟੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਦੁਖੁ ਹਉਮੈ ਰੋਗੁ ਗਵਾਇਓ ॥੨॥੨॥
lines.transliteration: jan naanak kau har bhete suaamee dukh haumai rog gavaaio ||2||2||
lines.translation: The Lord and Master has met servant Nanak, and the pain of the sickness of egotism has been eliminated. ||2||2||

lines.gurmukhi: ਬੈਰਾੜੀ ਮਹਲਾ ੪ ॥
lines.transliteration: bairaaRee mahalaa 4 ||
lines.translation: Bairaaree, Fourth Mehl:

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਜਨੁ ਰਾਮ ਨਾਮ ਗੁਨ ਗਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: har jan raam naam gun gaavai ||
lines.translation: The Lord's humble servant sings the Glorious Praises of the Lord's Name.

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੇ ਕੋਈ ਨਿੰਦ ਕਰੇ ਹਰਿ ਜਨ ਕੀ ਅਪੁਨਾ ਗੁਨੁ ਨ ਗਵਾਵੈ ॥੧॥ ਰਹਾਉ ॥
lines.transliteration: je koee ni(n)d kare har jan kee apunaa gun na gavaavai ||1|| rahaau ||
lines.translation: Even if someone slanders the Lord's humble servant, he does not give up his own goodness. ||1||Pause||

lines.gurmukhi: ਜੋ ਕਿਛੁ ਕਰੇ ਸੁ ਆਪੇ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਕਾਰ ਕਮਾਵੈ ॥
lines.transliteration: jo kichh kare s aape suaamee har aape kaar kamaavai ||
lines.translation: Whatever the Lord and Master does, He does by Himself; the Lord Himself does the deeds.

lines.gurmukhi: ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਹੀ ਮਤਿ ਦੇਵੈ ਸੁਆਮੀ ਹਰਿ ਆਪੇ ਬੋਲਿ ਬੁਲਾਵੈ ॥੧॥
lines.transliteration: har aape hee mat devai suaamee har aape bol bulaavai ||1||
lines.translation: The Lord and Master Himself imparts understanding; the Lord Himself inspires us to speak. ||1||
